'''Arris Rossum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the first wife of [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] and the mother of [[Iaclyn Stark|Iaclyn]], as well as [[Elli Stark|Elli]] after she had an affair with another man. She died in an accident in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].
